## Installation

You can install the development version of paparazzi from GitHub:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("posit-dev/paparazzi")
```

paparazzi controls Chrome (or another Chromium-based browser) through [chromote](https://rstudio.github.io/chromote/), so you'll need one installed. If chromote can't find it, see `?chromote::find_chrome`. Recording MP4 or WebM videos needs the [av](https://docs.ropensci.org/av/) package. GIFs need [gifski](https://r-rust.github.io/gifski/) instead, plus [png](https://cran.r-project.org/package=png) if you crop them to part of the page with a frame and av if they have captions.
